evals.prompt: Build an RNA-seq Graph with three parallel alignment Tasks after reference preparation, then merge the outputs. Use local heroes for every task.
evals.expected_output: JSON-only proposal that creates all five Tasks before assigning an acyclic prepare -> align_1/2/3 -> merge dependency graph. Each task sets hero and goal; dependencies live on task.depends.

evals.prompt: Change the existing merge Task to use global/bioinformatics-reviewer. Keep its goal and dependencies unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A minimal upsert_task operation using hero: global/bioinformatics-reviewer and the existing goal, with no dependency operation.

evals.prompt: Make task_a depend on task_b and task_b depend on task_a.
evals.expected_output: The proposal may represent the request, but Worker validation must identify the dependency cycle and prevent Apply.
